purpose: clean controlled replication: remove the relay confounder of s0 and test whether the speed gap persists

changes_vs_exploratory.thinking_level: low for both competitors (exploratory used high); requested by operator; constant across arms
changes_vs_exploratory.memory_limit: 6g for both (exploratory 4g). At 4 GiB two GLLA containers were killed mid-audit with no final state; at 6 GiB GLLA completed with ExitCode 0 and OOMKilled=false in a diagnostic run. Exact kill cause at 4 GiB was not captured (container removed before inspect).
changes_vs_exploratory.relay: unchanged image goalbench/relay:1 (decoupled reader, no forced Connection: close); no code changes after preflight
changes_vs_exploratory.collection: per-run volume snapshot immediately after each run (the exploratory collection read both trials from one volume)

pinned.model: deepseek-v4.1-flash (deepseek-v4.1-flash id), reasoning effort low, 1M context, max output 32768 per models.json

isolation: unchanged from s0: per-competitor internal network + relay, read-only rootfs, non-root, cap-drop, 2 CPU, pids 512, fresh volume per run
preflight: results/replication-preflight.json (24/24 requests succeeded, 0 relay failures, reasoning_effort=low observed upstream)
sleep_monitor: pmset -g log polled every 20s during each run; any new Sleep/Wake entry marks the run invalid
